content: SOPS+age: .sops.yaml creation_rules map filename_regex (e.g. secrets/.*.enc.yaml) to an age recipient public key; encrypted_regex limits which fields. Decrypt with SOPS_AGE_KEY (CI Actions secret) or SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE=~/.config/sops/age/keys.txt (VPS). 'sops -d --output-type dotenv secrets/staging.enc.yaml > .env' produces a gitignored runtime env consumed by docker compose. Current ~sops 3.13.0, age 1.3.1 (verify).
